row.proto: void *Career_Construct_RnDDeptCard(void *card, void *ctx, void *builder, void *allocator, const char *name, const char *icon, uint8_t dept)
row.notes: R&D department card/tab constructor; 0x950-byte object. Args (card, ctx = [builder+0x28], builder, allocator = [builder+0x298], name = lang key e.g. lng_rnd_dept_aero, icon = icon path cstr, dept = enum byte). Hashes name with djb2 (seed 0x1505, *0x21); copies icon into a NeStr at +0x818; stores dept at byte +0x6d8 and colour k_Career_RnDDeptColourTable[dept] (bound <6) at byte +0x948. Called 4x (once per stock dept) from Career_Build_RnDDeptBoxGrid.
